feature_weight_experiment.selection_rule: A candidate must beat C on pooled top-3 coverage and stay within 1.0 ROI percentage point for the 12-ticket 2-4-5 narrowed trio portfolio (19 x 100-yen units allocated across 12 tickets; 1,900 yen per race), and must independently beat C top-3 coverage while staying within the same ROI tolerance in every prior development fold. Among eligible candidates, rank by pooled top3, then top1, then trio ROI. The latest one-year holdout is untouched.
feature_weight_experiment.trio_comparison_policy: 12 unique 2-4-5 narrowed tickets per race, 19 x 100-yen units allocated equally, fixed 1,900-yen race budget; identical race set for every model.

holdout_comparison.note: Candidate remains research-only. Promotion requires repeatable improvement in ranking and 12-ticket trio ROI on independent future holdout data; this single selected holdout does not change live weights.

market_rank_diagnostics.rank_gap_definition: market rank minus LAB rank; positive means LAB ranks the horse higher
market_rank_diagnostics.comparison_policy: LAB and market ranks are recomputed on the same horses with valid official final odds in each race; outcomes are official finishing positions.

method.weight_policy: Ablations remove one learned B-model feature and renormalize. Single-feature challengers scale one learned weight; D1-D4 apply the predefined jockey/venue/distance multipliers together and normalize once. Candidate selection uses the two earlier chronological development folds and the same 12-ticket, 1,900-yen trio portfolio, then assesses the selected candidate on the untouched final-year holdout.
method.market_data: Official final confirmed odds are retrospective only and were not available before the race. This is a market benchmark, not a live pre-off comparison.
method.selection: All model and market picks are compared on the same holdout races with available official final odds.
method.production_impact: Diagnostic only. No live model weights, predictions, or G4 preregistered value thresholds are changed.
method.interpretation: Compare winner_top1_rate first. A feature whose removal improves the top-1 rate is a candidate for deeper review, not automatic deletion. Check sample size and uncertainty before any change.
